title: 蛍の光 (Hotaru no Hikari — Light of the Firefly)
description: Japan's iconic graduation and farewell song, sung at school ceremonies and year-end store closings since 1881. Set to the Scottish melody of 'Auld Lang Syne,' the lyrics describe studying by the light of fireflies and moonlit snow — legendary symbols of scholarly dedication. The first two verses are standard; verses three and four contain Meiji-era patriotic content rarely sung today.
